title: Yen Carry-Trade Unwind (Jul–Aug 2024)
description: A Bank of Japan hike plus a weak US jobs report forced a rapid unwind of yen-funded positions; high-beta tech and crypto were hit hardest. Shocks are real total returns (Yahoo Finance adjusted close) from 2024-07-31 to 2024-08-05.
source_name: Yahoo Finance (adjusted close); events cited in references
transmission: 2024-07-31: Bank of Japan raises its policy rate to around 0.25% and plans to cut JGB purchases [1]
2024-08-02: US July payrolls +114,000; unemployment rate rises to 4.3% [2]
